name: Dynamite Baseball
summary: Dynamite Baseball is a baseball game released for Sega Model 2 arcade hardware. It was developed by Sega AM1, including many of the same people behind AM1's previous baseball game Final Arch. It is controlled using a bat switch, similar to Major League. It uses the same "Virtua Advertising" system pioneered by Virtua Striker, with advertisements for 15 companies appearing the game. The game was installed in some Versus City cabinets, like Final Arch before it.
